text: Ingests error events from applications using Sentry's open-source SDKs
quote: GlitchTip can use Sentry's open source SDKs to receive error data from your application.

text: Supports uploading JavaScript source maps to unminify stack traces, with a CLI to inject debug IDs
quote: For JavaScript projects, upload source maps to get readable stack traces. Use the GlitchTip CLI (Beta) to inject debug IDs and upload source maps

text: Teams can be created per project to control who gets notified about errors
quote: When making a project, you will also need to create a team if you have not already done so. Teams are for making sure the right people get notified when an error is reported.

text: Project alerts can notify via email or a webhook recipient added to the project
quote: By default, new project alerts send emails to a project's team members, but you can also add a webhook URL by clicking “Add An Alert Recipient.”

text: Official CLI can create new releases tied to an org/project
Built-in performance monitoring surfaces slow web requests and database calls without dashboard setup
quote: GlitchTip takes a simple, works out of the box approach. No dashboard building and metrics hunting. Just find your slowest web requests, database calls, and other transactions.

text: Uptime monitoring pings a site and alerts via email or webhook when it's unresponsive
quote: GlitchTip can ping your site and warn you when it's not responding. ... If GlitchTip doesn't receive your ping, it will send you an alert via email or webhook.

text: Application logs can be searched and filtered alongside errors and performance data in one place
quote: Search and filter your application logs alongside your errors and performance data. Keep everything in one place for faster debugging.

text: Includes a built-in MCP server to let AI tools pull error data without sharing it externally
quote: GlitchTip has a built-in MCP server so you can pull your own error data into your preferred AI tools with no data sharing required.

text: Lets users browse issues, inspect stack traces and event data, and resolve issues
quote: Investigate errors — Browse issues, inspect stack traces and event data, and resolve issues

text: Aims for Sentry API compatibility so Sentry-integrated tools and SDKs work with GlitchTip
quote: GlitchTip aims to be Sentry API compatible. Anything that works with Sentry should also work with GlitchTip.

text: Integrates with GitLab error tracking by configuring it as a Sentry-compatible endpoint
quote: In GitLab, navigate to a project's Settings > Monitor > Error Tracking. Click to enable tracking. Select "Sentry" and enter the GlitchTip URL

text: Can be added as a Grafana data source via the Sentry data source type
quote: In Grafana, navigate to Configuration > Data sources, click "Add data source". In the search field, type "Sentry".
